# Planstrand Code of Conduct

We welcome participation regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, experience, nationality, appearance, race, religion, or sexual orientation.

## Expected behavior

Be respectful, constructive, and considerate. Critique ideas and code rather than people, accept feedback in good faith, and respect privacy and differing perspectives.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory language, sexual attention, personal attacks, and publishing private information without consent are unacceptable.

## Scope and enforcement

This policy applies in Planstrand project spaces and when representing the project publicly. Maintainers may edit or remove inappropriate content, restrict participation, or ban participants, proportionate to the behavior and its impact. Repeated or severe misconduct may result in an immediate ban.

Report inappropriate GitHub content through its **Report content** menu. For moderation requests that contain no private details, contact `@hychaw` in the relevant project issue or discussion. Do not post sensitive reports or personal information publicly; use GitHub's private reporting mechanism for abusive content. No dedicated private project contact address is currently published.

Maintainers should handle reports fairly, respect reporter privacy, and explain moderation decisions where appropriate.
